###-begin-notes-completions-###
#
# Static completion script for Zsh
#
# Installation:
#   notes --completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_notes
#   then add ~/.zsh/completions to your fpath
#

_notes() {
  local -a specs
  specs=(
    '(--format -f)--format[Output format]:value:(md txt)'
    '(--format -f)-f[Output format]:value:(md txt)'
    ':Note to open:_files'
  )
  _arguments "${specs[@]}"
}

# Handle both direct invocation and autoload
if [[ "${zsh_eval_context[-1]}" == "loadautofunc" ]]; then
  _notes "$@"
else
  compdef _notes notes
fi
###-end-notes-completions-###
